title: Add local-only backup, restore, and reset for Story Bible drafts
description: After the local-only Story Bible boundary is explicit, add a front-end-only portability flow for the 5 draft fields: export a versioned JSON payload, import it back into the panel, and reset the local draft keys without including graph-derived character or location data.

criteria: 1 export action writes a versioned payload containing exactly 5 draft fields: `[braindump, genres, synopsis, outline, style]`.
1 import action restores those same 5 fields from a previously exported file and rejects malformed payloads with a visible error state.
1 reset action clears only Story Bible local draft keys and leaves graph-backed character and location loading behavior unchanged.
convergence.verification: npm --prefix desktop run test -- src/components/StoryBiblePanel.test.tsx && npm --prefix desktop run typecheck
convergence.definition_of_done: Story Bible remains honestly local-only, but users now have an explicit backup and recovery path instead of relying on opaque localStorage persistence.

implementation.title: Define the local draft payload
implementation.description: Create a small versioned schema for Story Bible export and import that includes only the 5 local draft fields and excludes graph-derived data.

implementation.description: Create or extend the focused `StoryBiblePanel` test surface and docs so backup, restore, reset, and invalid payload handling are exercised and documented.
